title: UmbracoSearchExamineSchema
description:
Describes this provider's own slice of the configuration tree, for generating its
appsettings-schema.Umbraco.Cms.Search.Examine.json fragment at build time.

Umbraco.description: Gets or sets the configuration for this provider.

UmbracoDefinition.description: Configuration container for all Umbraco products.

CMS.description: Gets or sets the configuration of Umbraco CMS.

Search.description: Gets or sets the configuration of Umbraco Search providers.

Examine.description: Gets or sets the configuration of the Examine search provider.

ExamineSearchProviderSettings.description: Typed configuration options for the Examine provider for Umbraco Search.

ZeroDowntimeIndexing.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether index rebuilds should use zero-downtime indexing
(an active and a shadow index per index alias, swapped when a rebuild completes).

LuceneDirectoryFactory.description: Gets or sets a value for the Lucene directory factory type.
Specifies the Lucene directory factory type for Examine indexes.
